review.title: Seven Decades of Weighted Trajectory Splitting (1951 to 2026)
paragraphs: Weighted Ensemble simulation descends from two converging intellectual streams. In Monte Carlo transport and polymer physics, particle splitting with inverse statistical weight assignment originated with von Neumann and Kahn and entered chemical physics through chain enrichment in [Rosenbluth & Rosenbluth 1955](node:31) and [Wall & Erpenbeck 1959](node:132). Independently, biomolecular Brownian dynamics developed staged reaction coordinate windows for diffusional barrier crossing in [Northrup, McCammon & Karplus 1980](node:205) alongside inner encounter and outer escape surfaces in [Northrup, Allison & McCammon 1984](node:94) and cycle flux kinetics in [Hill 1989](node:29). [Huber & Kim 1996](node:109) unified staged encounter bins with statistically exact splitting and merging at fixed intervals tau under the name Weighted Ensemble.

A second wave generalized Weighted Ensemble beyond Brownian association to arbitrary stochastic dynamics. [Zhang et al. 2007](node:242) and [Zhang, Jasnow & Zuckerman 2010](node:252) proved path ensemble unbiasedness across general Markovian and non Markovian dynamics with time dependent bins, while [Bhatt, Zhang & Zuckerman 2010](node:262) established steady state probability reweighting and [Suarez et al. 2014](node:422) introduced history labeled alpha and beta ensembles eliminating coarse Markovian rate bias. Community software matured around [Zwier et al. 2015](node:332) (WESTPA), [Zuckerman & Chong 2017](node:351), Lotz & Dickson 2020 (wepy), and [Russo et al. 2022](node:536) (WESTPA 2.0).

Over the past decade, adaptive topology and mathematical optimality conquered high dimensional progress coordinates and million atom assemblies. Hierarchical Voronoi bins in [Dickson & Brooks 2014](node:328) (WExplore), binless pairwise variation optimization in Donyapour, Roussey & Dickson 2019 (REVO), Minimal Adaptive Binning in [Torrillo, Bogetti & Chong 2021](node:493) (MAB), and discrepancy optimal walker allocation in [Aristoff & Zuckerman 2020](node:390) and [Aristoff et al. 2023](node:570) drove atomistic milestones ranging from viral spike glycan gating in [Sztain et al. 2021](node:517) to transient corrected event duration rates in [DeGrave, Bogetti & Chong 2021](node:499) (RED), history augmented Markov models in [Copperman & Zuckerman 2020](node:475), and discretization free steady state reweighting in [Kania et al. 2026](node:733) (RiteWeight).

review.title: Foundations & Exact Resampling
paragraphs: Early targeted path sampling protocols including soft ratcheting [Zuckerman & Woolf 2002](node:263) and coarse grained calmodulin transition sampling [Zuckerman 2003](node:41) highlighted the challenge of generating rare barrier crossings without distorting reactive trajectory weights, while equilibrium sampling theory [Zuckerman 2011](node:294) quantified trajectory efficiency through inverse global correlation times. [Zhang, Jasnow & Zuckerman 2010](node:252) recast Weighted Ensemble splitting and pruning into exact path space resampling, proving statistical exactness across Markovian and non Markovian stochastic processes alongside dynamic and adaptive Voronoi tessellations. Scale agnostic unbiased resampling subsequently expanded to Gillespie chemical reaction networks [Donovan Maiye et al. 2013](node:67), distributed master worker molecular dynamics [Abdul Wahid et al. 2014](node:171), spatial reaction diffusion models [Donovan Maiye et al. 2016](node:321), upper confidence bound adaptive exploration [Perez et al. 2020](node:454), epidemic extinction networks [Korngut, Vilk & Assaf 2025](node:660), and Girsanov reweighted collective variable path lifting [Schutte et al. 2026](node:711).

Mathematical formalization transformed heuristic stratification rules into quantitative variance reduction theory. In sequential particle filtering, [Douc, Cappe & Moulines 2005](node:273) proved that residual and stratified schemes strictly reduce conditional variance relative to multinomial resampling while constructing an ordering counterexample for systematic resampling, motivating negative association and Hilbert curve ordered resampling achieving o(N^{-(1+1/d)}) variance [Gerber, Chopin & Whiteley 2019](node:364). For Weighted Ensemble dynamics, [Aristoff 2018](node:347) introduced a selection mutation martingale framework proving unbiasedness and coarse model replica optimization, [Webber, Aristoff & Simpson 2020](node:488) derived matching asymptotic variance bounds mu(v_f)^2 / N governed by the Optimal Improvement Factor, and [Aristoff 2022](node:503) proved an almost sure ergodic theorem alongside exact finite N variance decompositions demonstrating why discrepancy weighted walker allocation outperforms uniform bin occupancy.

Extracting stationary populations and mean first passage times from short Weighted Ensemble segments exposed subtle post simulation estimator biases whenever coarse bins violate local equilibrium. [Suarez et al. 2014](node:422) partitioned bin populations into directional history labeled alpha and beta components, eliminating Markovian lumping bias on non Markovian progress coordinates and motivating basin colored rate ratio free energy corrections [Hall, Dixon & Dickson 2020](node:463). [Russo, Copperman & Zuckerman 2020](node:465) bypassed transition matrix construction via self consistent iterative trajectory reweighting, [Bose, Kilinc & Dickson 2025](node:661) identified and removed multi step trajectory merging bias when Markov lag times exceed the resampling interval, and [Aristoff, Webber & Zuckerman 2026](node:742) proved analytically why equilibrium weighted coarse transition matrices fail to reproduce directional source sink steady states.

review.title: Steady State, Hill Flux & Non Markovian Rates
paragraphs: [Bhatt, Zhang & Zuckerman 2010](node:182) generalized Weighted Ensemble path sampling to nonequilibrium source sink steady states through the Hill reciprocal flux identity, and [Donovan Maiye et al. 2013](node:67) extended feedback steady state sampling to stochastic chemical kinetics networks with thousands of coupled reactions. Cell restricted flux balance in [Vanden Eijnden & Venturoli 2009](node:133) established that exact steady state rate recovery requires boundary reinjection consistent with conditional hitting fluxes and transition path theory committors. [Baudel, Guyader & Lelievre 2023](node:470) proved that inverse stationary sink flux coincides with the equilibrium mean reaction time strictly when recycled trajectories sample the reactive boundary entry measure on reactant boundary A rather than a restricted Boltzmann slice or quasi stationary distribution. For steady state linear algebra over rare event weights spanning dozens of decades, regenerative sojourn elimination in [Grassmann, Taksar & Heyman 1985](node:93) and censored chain RG factorization in [Zhao 2021](node:489) avoid floating point subtraction, while [Aristoff & Zuckerman 2020](node:390) derived Doob martingale variance minimizing bin and walker allocations and [Cetiner 2024](node:652) formulated nonequilibrium steady state probabilities through loop erased path action functionals.

Finite barrier crossing durations create systematic pre steady state transients long before macroscopic relaxation completes. [Zhang, Jasnow & Zuckerman 2007](node:245) derived the absorbing boundary Fokker Planck density of transition event durations normalized by splitting probability and demonstrated dependence on global anharmonic potential shape rather than harmonic barrier top curvature alone, complementing the trajectory ensemble framework surveyed in [Zuckerman & Russo 2021](node:481). [Copperman et al. 2019](node:399) proved via a parabolic maximum principle that spatial extrema of one dimensional Smoluchowski currents bound steady state flux monotonically while constructing two dimensional counterexamples to monotonic decay. Building on explicit solvent barnase barstar association pathways from [Saglam & Chong 2019](node:400), [DeGrave, Bogetti & Chong 2021](node:499) introduced the Rate from Event Durations (RED) estimator, dividing cumulative flux by the integrated event duration distribution to remove twofold pre steady state rate underestimation. Complementary steady state output analyses remove startup bias via MSER 5 truncation in [White 1997](node:287) and [White, Cobb & Spratt 2002](node:548) and eliminate negative first order batch means variance bias under positive autocorrelation via lugsail lag windows in [Vats & Flegal 2021](node:461).

Coarse spatial partitions violate Markovian assumptions when slow orthogonal coordinates persist within simulation bins. [Suarez & Zuckerman 2014](node:308) resolved coarse partition memory bias by splitting populations into two color alpha and beta ensembles labeled by last macrostate visited, and [Pratt et al. 2019](node:417) benchmarked online history tracking alongside post simulation history augmented Markov state models (haMSMs) across molecular association and dissociation benchmarks. [Copperman & Zuckerman 2020](node:411) and [Copperman & Zuckerman 2020](node:475) constructed fine microbin haMSM operators from pre steady state Weighted Ensemble segments, an estimator scaled to terabyte viral spike opening trajectories in [Dommer et al. 2022](node:563) and contrasted with trajectory stratification in [Strahan et al. 2024](node:647) and milestoning hybrids in [Ray & Andricioaei 2020](node:443) and [Ray et al. 2020](node:468). Eliminating fixed cluster boundaries altogether, [Kania et al. 2026](node:733) proved that Randomized Iterative Trajectory Reweighting (RiteWeight) across fresh random hyperplane tessellations converges to the exact microstate stationary distribution without cluster level Markovianity, supporting equilibrium rectification of AI seeded adenylate kinase ensembles in [Otten et al. 2026](node:725) and DeepTICA latent clustering in [Kania 2026](node:752).

review.title: Adaptive Binning & Allocation
paragraphs: Adaptive partitioning in Weighted Ensemble sampling evolved to overcome exponential M^d grid growth inherent to static Cartesian bins introduced by [Huber & Kim 1996](node:109) and [Huber & McCammon 1997](node:208). [Adelman & Grabe 2013](node:253) restricted high dimensional sampling to one dimensional adaptive Voronoi strings along principal reaction tubes, while [Donovan Maiye et al. 2013](node:67) characterized automatic state space division for unknown target basins among major open problems. To explore multi basin macromolecular ensembles without predefined endpoints, [Dickson & Brooks 2014](node:328) and [Dickson et al. 2014](node:272) introduced hierarchical Voronoi tessellations in WExplore, capturing HIV 1 TAR RNA interhelical states missed by microsecond special purpose trajectories. Hard Voronoi distance cutoffs still caused discontinuous cloning jumps across cell boundaries, motivating [Donyapour, Roussey & Dickson 2019](node:427) and [Lotz & Dickson 2020](node:487) to formulate Resampling of Ensembles by Variation Optimization (REVO) around pairwise trajectory distances and logarithmic weight novelty. Blind SAMPL6 evaluations in [Rizzi et al. 2020](node:450) exposed systematic rate ratio free energy offsets and quasi unbound over cloning in standard REVO, spurring finite volume boundary corrections in [Hall, Dixon & Dickson 2020](node:463), quasi unbound cloning cutoffs in [Roussey & Dickson 2022](node:569), and merging bias corrected Markov models in [Bose, Kilinc & Dickson 2025](node:661).

Along low dimensional progress coordinates, [Torrillo, Bogetti & Chong 2021](node:493) developed Minimal Adaptive Binning (MAB), bracketing active outer extrema each cycle and isolating lagging, leading, and uphill bottleneck trajectories without preliminary trial runs. Deployed inside WESTPA 2.0 by [Russo et al. 2022](node:536), MAB raised two dimensional p53 bin occupancy from 17 percent under manual grids to 66 percent and accelerated multimillion atom viral spike opening in [Dommer et al. 2022](node:563), peptide bilayer translocation in [Choe 2023](node:573), and Abl1 kinase DFG flips in [Monteiro da Silva 2024](node:638). Cartesian products of MAB intervals remain impractical beyond three progress dimensions and exhibited rule breaking trajectory merges on seconds timescale kinesin Eg5 ADP dissociation in [Bogetti et al. 2025](node:678), motivating Minimal Adaptive Binless (MABL) resampling on a scalar composite score alongside TICA projected binless search in [Mitra, Biswas & Chakrabarty 2025](node:659) and temporal coherence binless resampling in [Shahid, Maity & Chakrabarty 2026](node:726).

Rigorous variance optimization initiated by [Aristoff 2018](node:347) and [Aristoff & Zuckerman 2020](node:390) decomposed Weighted Ensemble steady state flux error into selection and mutation martingale increments, establishing that optimal walker counts scale with bin weight times intrabin one step flux discrepancy standard deviation w_i sigma_i rather than equal walkers per bin. [Aristoff et al. 2023](node:570) expressed flux discrepancy through local mean first passage times and demonstrated on two dimensional Smoluchowski surfaces that equal pi*v discrepancy bins lower normalized flux variance by three to five orders of magnitude relative to radial bins whereas naive radial bins underperform brute force. [Strahan et al. 2024](node:647) extended trajectory stratification ideas to nonequilibrium umbrella sampling, and [Ryu et al. 2026](node:705) combined history augmented Markov models with equal pi*v discrepancy bins on atomistic NTL9 folding at water like friction, narrowing replicate flux spread from 35 orders of magnitude to 12 orders of magnitude.

review.title: History Augmented MSMs & Koopman Models
paragraphs: Classical conformational Markov state models approximate transfer operator eigenfunctions on discrete state partitions validated through implied relaxation timescales and reversible maximum likelihood transition matrices [Prinz et al. 2011](node:222), slow linear subspaces from time lagged independent component analysis [Perez Hernandez et al. 2013](node:282), reactive flux decompositions from transition path theory [Metzner et al. 2009](node:180), and semi Markov surface operators in milestoning [Vanden Eijnden et al. 2008](node:203) and Exact Milestoning [Aristoff et al. 2016](node:51). Reanalyzing sub millisecond atomistic folding trajectories of Chignolin, Trp cage, Villin, and NTL9, [Suarez et al. 2021](node:495) demonstrated that variationally validated reversible Markov state models still underestimate mean first passage times by an order of magnitude or more until lag times approach 100 ns, consistent with tenfold Markov state model rate overestimation relative to 19F EXSY NMR in HIV 1 capsid CTD dimer interconversion [Yang et al. 2025](node:668).

History augmented Markov state models resolve short lag recrossing bias by partitioning walkers according to last visited macrostate labels introduced in color labeled flux formulations [Darve & Ryu 2012](node:318) and equilibrium Weighted Ensemble rate matrices [Suarez et al. 2014](node:422). Enforcing reversible detailed balance across pooled trajectories mixes forward alpha and reverse beta steady states and corrupts first passage currents, whereas unsymmetrized alpha transition matrices recover exact mean first passage times at the molecular dynamics frame interval [Suarez et al. 2021](node:495) and loop erased pathway histograms [Suarez & Zuckerman 2018](node:398). Extending coarse graining theory in an unpublished preprint, [Russo et al. 2021](node:510) proved that coarse transition matrices recover unbiased mean first passage times and committors strictly under source sink boundary conditions once sliding window weights relax, clarifying empirical initial density weighting in modern transfer operator syntheses [Zuckerman et al. 2026](node:756).

Recent mathematical work couples spectral Koopman approximations and variational objective functions with trajectory stratification to accelerate convergence beyond unbiased relaxation rates. Building on goal oriented adaptive exploration [Zimmerman & Bowman 2015](node:341), [Aristoff et al. 2023](node:570) derived exact asymptotic flux variance bounds governed by the flux discrepancy h(x) and local variation v(x), proving naive coordinate bins can perform worse than brute force sampling. Subsequent estimators combine Galerkin basis expansions with nonequilibrium umbrella sampling in BAD NEUS [Strahan et al. 2024](node:647), binless TICA guided walker splitting in WeTICA [Mitra et al. 2025](node:659), RiteWeight regularized coarse chain parameter sensitivities [Strahan & Gingrich 2026](node:749), and neural semigroup committor learning inside Weighted Ensemble loops in WELP [Chen et al. 2026](node:759).

review.title: Software, GPU Engines & Workflows
paragraphs: Production Weighted Ensemble software decouples intermittent walker resampling from underlying stochastic dynamics engines [Zuckerman & Chong 2017](node:351), pairing extensible GPU Langevin integrators in OpenMM 7 [Eastman et al. 2017](node:416) and Amber with parallel Python work managers standardized in the WESTPA 1.0 tutorial suite [Bogetti et al. 2019](node:435). Addressing million file storage limits and slow steady state relaxation on exascale resources, WESTPA 2.0 [Russo et al. 2022](node:536) introduced per iteration HDF5 trajectory containers that cut disk footprints by 27 to 85 percent, cloud ready Python APIs scaling across thousands of GPUs, event duration rate tools, and haMSM restarting plugins documented in the v2.0 tutorials [Bogetti et al. 2023](node:579) and deployed on terabyte scale Delta spike opening simulations [Dommer et al. 2022](node:563).

Complementary object oriented design in wepy [Lotz & Dickson 2020](node:487) separates Runner, Resampler, BoundaryConditions, and WepyHDF5 clone merge lineage graphs to support regionless REVO and hierarchical Voronoi WExplore workflows. Recording explicit parent child cloning and merging graphs allows continuous reactive path reconstruction for ion coupled host guest unbinding [Roussey et al. 2022](node:532) while exposing merging truncation and quasi unbound over cloning biases corrected via Cutoff REVO [Roussey & Dickson 2022](node:569). Parallel algorithmic audits in WESTPA refined ascending weight Huber Kim pruning to lower within bin resampling variance [Plotnikov & Ahn 2024](node:645) alongside diagnostic 10^-100 weight underflow checks reviewed in [Chong & Zuckerman 2025](node:691).

Downstream mechanistic and force field validation workflows increasingly couple Weighted Ensemble trajectory archives with automated clustering and experimental benchmark suites. LPATH [Bogetti et al. 2023](node:616) discretizes configuration space via two stage machine learning clustering and aligns condensed state strings to classify transition routes, complementing graph shortest path fundamental sequences [Suarez & Zuckerman 2018](node:398). At the force field level, standardized NMR scalar coupling, NOE, and relaxation datasets [Cavender et al. 2023](node:581) join WESTPA driven TICA Kullback Leibler and Wasserstein benchmarks spanning nine protein topologies to audit classical and machine learned molecular dynamics propagators [Aghili et al. 2025](node:695).

review.title: Ligand Binding, Unbinding & Residence Time
paragraphs: Weighted Ensemble resampling transformed atomistic drug dissociation kinetics from an intractable barrier problem into an unbiased path-ensemble calculation. Introducing hierarchical Voronoi stratification in WExplore [Dickson 2014](node:328), Dickson and collaborators mapped multi-pathway ligand release for FKBP12 fragments [Dickson 2016](node:338), trypsin-benzamidine [Dickson 2017](node:358), and soluble epoxide hydrolase bound to TPPU, reaching a 42 s computed residence time against an 11 min experimental lifetime from 6 microseconds of aggregate molecular dynamics [Lotz 2018](node:375). Across bromodomain inhibitors Brd4-MS436 and Baz2B-ICR7, WExplore exit-rate rankings matched crystallographic poses and demonstrated that 81 percent of interconversions between deep poses pass through the unbound state [Dickson 2018](node:419), while Voronoi WESTPA runs resolved four exit channels for benzene escaping the interior T4 lysozyme L99A cavity [Nunes-Alves 2018](node:379). Regionless Resampling of Ensembles by Variation Optimization (REVO) removed spatial bin walls by maximizing pairwise walker variation [Donyapour 2019](node:427), discovering a fourth trypsin-benzamidine exit route and extending unbiased dissociation to targeted protein degrader SMARCA2-VHL PROTAC ternary complexes restrained by hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry [Dixon 2022](node:565), molecular glues at the DCAF15-RBM39 interface [Atik 2026](node:673), and engineered CGRP peptides exhibiting intermediate recapture on CLR-RAMP1 [Kılınç 2026](node:707).

Thermodynamic self-consistency between kinetic fluxes and equilibrium affinities exposed subtle boundary and statistical estimator pitfalls. In the blind SAMPL6 SAMPLing host-guest benchmark [Rizzi 2020](node:450), initial REVO rate-ratio binding free energies [Dixon 2018](node:388) were 3 to 5 kcal/mol too negative relative to alchemical perturbation due to unmodeled finite periodic box volume, state-boundary definitions, and residual host-guest electrostatic interactions at the 1 nm unbound cutoff. Deriving exact trajectory-ensemble corrections reduced the OA-G6 benchmark error from 3.4 to 0.76 kcal/mol [Hall 2020](node:463), reanalysis uncovered 10^6-fold unbinding weight sensitivity to local sodium depletion [Roussey 2022](node:532), and Cutoff-REVO suppressed unproductive cloning in quasi-unbound states to achieve -5.00 +- 0.66 kcal/mol prospective accuracy in SAMPL9 [Roussey 2022](node:569). Parallel hybrid formulations embedded Weighted Ensemble inside milestoning cells in WEM [Ray 2020](node:468) and continuous Voronoi-tessellated Markovian Weighted Ensemble Milestoning (M-WEM) [Ray 2021](node:538), though dimensional audits of printed WEM formulas [Ray 2020](node:468) confirm the requirement for strict 1 M standard-state volume normalization [Gilson 1997](node:125) and [Boresch 2003](node:207).

Postprocessing resampled ligand trajectories and surmounting polar or interior-cavity barriers define the current methodological frontier. Constructing naive count-based Markov state models across REVO resampling steps for soluble epoxide hydrolase TPPU analogs [Bose 2023](node:611) introduced asymmetric walker termination bias that compressed median unbinding times to 0.96 min until Merging-Bias-Corrected Markov state models (MBC-MSM) restored a ~50 min median mean first-passage time against 27.1 min experiment [Bose 2025](node:661). For interior THS-017 escape from HIF-2alpha PAS-B, three-stage Minimal Adaptive Binning steady-state Weighted Ensemble generated over 4000 pathways and pinpointed gating residue N288 confirmed by mutagenesis NMR while producing k_off four orders of magnitude faster than ZZ-exchange NMR [Silvestrini 2024](node:654). Similarly, seconds-timescale release of highly charged ADP from kinesin Eg5 motivated Minimal Adaptive Binless (MABL) Weighted Ensemble, cutting aggregate sampling to first release from 4.7 microseconds down to 2.0 microseconds without converging a macroscopic off-rate [Bogetti 2025](node:678).

review.title: Protein Association & Brownian Dynamics
paragraphs: Weighted Ensemble originated in diffusion-influenced bimolecular association [Huber 1996](node:109) by marrying trajectory splitting with the spherical surface formalism of Northrup, Allison, and McCammon [Northrup 1984](node:94). In the Northrup-Allison-McCammon geometry applied earlier to cytochrome c encounter complexes [Northrup 1988](node:181), reactants initiate on an isotropic inner b-sphere and either bind or cross an outer truncation q-sphere, where analytical Smoluchowski flux matching corrects finite-q escape probability to infinite dilution [Northrup 1984](node:94). Embedding Weighted Ensemble splitting between the inner b-sphere and outer q-sphere in Brownian dynamics [Huber 1996](node:109) and UHBD [Rojnuckarin 2000](node:126), and later extending Brownian resampling to non-potential steady states down to probabilities of 10^-300 [Kromer 2013](node:187) and multiscale Brownian-atomistic milestoning [Votapka 2015](node:55), overcame the severe attrition of brute-force diffusional encounter searches. Incorporating flexible pseudoatomic protein models with intermolecular and intramolecular hydrodynamic interactions in UIOWA_BD permitted explicit simulation of the millisecond-timescale basal k_on = (2.85 +- 1.30) x 10^6 M^-1 s^-1 for uncharged hydrophobic isosteres of barnase and barstar at 6-fold to 131-fold computational savings [Saglam 2015](node:312).

Stepping from Brownian dynamics to continuous atomistic dynamics clarified both conformational recognition pathways and disorder-mediated binding kinetics. Implicit-solvent WESTPA simulations of the MDM2 oncoprotein and intrinsically disordered p53 transactivation peptide generated 182 atomistic pathways and k_on = (7 +- 4) x 10^7 M^-1 s^-1 [Zwier 2016](node:346), while controlled Brownian dynamics Weighted Ensemble runs on exact preorganized p53 analogues established that helical preorganization preserves k_on unchanged within error relative to disordered chains [Saglam 2017](node:370). Full explicit-solvent GROMACS WESTPA simulations of ~100,000-atom barnase-barstar solvated in TIP3P then captured 203 continuous association pathways across 18 microseconds of aggregate simulation, producing k_on = (2.3 +- 1.0) x 10^8 M^-1 s^-1 in quantitative agreement with experimental (2.86 +- 0.7) x 10^8 M^-1 s^-1 and resolving encounter-complex reorganization across rotational diffusion bottlenecks [Saglam 2019](node:400). Reanalyzing the 18-microsecond barnase-barstar dataset with the Rate from Event Durations (RED) estimator conditioned on the 6 ns modal barrier-crossing duration improved rate convergence efficiency by more than 25 percent [DeGrave 2021](node:499) and [Russo 2022](node:536), and steady-state Minimal Adaptive Binning Weighted Ensemble with AMBER ff15ipq [Debiec 2016](node:342) later matched 19F EXSY NMR interconversion rates between visible D1 and hidden D2 dimers of the HIV-1 capsid C-terminal domain where standard Markov models ran tenfold too fast [Yang 2025](node:668).

Quantitative audit of explicit-solvent bimolecular rates requires disentangling solvent shear viscosity errors from periodic box hydrodynamics. Rigid three-point TIP3P water exhibits a shear viscosity roughly 2.5-fold below experiment at ambient temperature [González 2010](node:224), artificially accelerating solute diffusion, whereas four-point OPC water sits 10 percent below experiment at 298 K, 20 percent below at 273 K, and matches experiment above 310 K [Ando 2023](node:607). Simultaneously, periodic boundary conditions in finite cubic boxes of side L retard each diffusing macromolecule by the Ewald hydrodynamic self-interaction k_B T xi / (6 pi eta L) [Yeh 2004](node:183) codified in simulation transport guidelines [Braun 2018](node:403). In millimolar explicit-solvent association setups exemplified by the 956 nm^3 barnase-barstar box [Saglam 2019](node:400), uncorrected periodic Oseen drag and underestimated solvent viscosity act in opposite directions, motivating routine reporting of viscosity-scaled and Ewald-corrected diffusivities alongside raw Weighted Ensemble flux estimates.

review.title: Protein Folding & Disordered Ensembles
paragraphs: Atomistic protein folding and conformational switching formed the primary proving ground for non-Markovian rate estimators and variance-reduction theory in Weighted Ensemble. Early trajectory stratification sampled flow-dependent unfolding of a 262-nucleotide RNA with mean first-passage times reaching 1.4 s [Dickson 2011](node:196) and 522 chignolin configurations via WExplore [Dickson 2014](node:328), while Brownian Weighted Ensemble on an alternate-frame-folding calbindin Ca2+ sensor guided Phe-to-Ala mutations that accelerated experimental switching up to 32-fold [DeGrave 2018](node:380). Reanalyzing sub-millisecond Anton trajectories for chignolin, Trp-cage, villin, and NTL9 demonstrated that Markov state models require lag times near 100 ns to avoid order-of-magnitude mean first-passage time underestimates, whereas non-Markovian history-labeled estimators recover exact folding times and pathway statistics at the trajectory frame interval [Suárez 2016](node:343) and [Suárez 2021](node:495). Combining GPU AMBER implicit-solvent Weighted Ensemble with microbin history-augmented Markov models extended continuous atomistic folding to NTL9 at water-like friction (0.2 to 1.9 ms) and Protein G [Adhikari 2019](node:414), where subsequent audits corrected the misreported zero-denaturant Protein G experimental benchmark from ~1 s to 2 to 40 ms [Adhikari 2021](node:505) and restarted Weighted Ensemble from microbin steady states to reach 0.3 to 4.3 ms [Copperman 2020](node:475).

Severe run-to-run flux dispersion in multi-millisecond folding catalyzed rigorous uncertainty quantification, synthetic benchmarking, and optimal trajectory allocation. Across 15 NTL9 and 13 Protein G Weighted Ensemble replicates, individual run fluxes spanned 20 and 70 orders of magnitude, causing both standard and Bayesian bootstrap 95 percent intervals to miss the true mean in roughly 30 percent of synthetic trials [Mostofian 2019](node:407), while Smoluchowski transient current bounds verified monotonic steady-state approach on water-friction NTL9 [Copperman 2019](node:399). Generative fine-grained Markov synthetic molecular dynamics (synMD) producing over 200 ms/day of atomistic Trp-cage trajectories [Russo 2022](node:539) permitted controlled benchmarking of unsupervised progress-coordinate discovery, including reinforcement-learning coordinate weighting [Shamsi 2018](node:369), on-the-fly convolutional variational autoencoder outlier splitting on NTL9 (>3-fold rate speedup) [Leung 2025](node:672), discretization-free Randomized Iterative Trajectory Reweighting (RiteWeight) [Kania 2026](node:733), and discrepancy-variance optimal binning that compressed high-friction NTL9 flux spread from 35 orders of magnitude down to 12 orders [Ryu 2026](node:705).

In explicit solvent, Weighted Ensemble paired with the salt-bridge-balanced AMBER ff15ipq force field [Debiec 2016](node:342) and Minimal Adaptive Binning resolved both intrinsically disordered ensembles and unnatural-backbone folding mechanisms. On the disordered p53 peptide, Minimal Adaptive Binning occupied 66 percent of adaptive bins versus 17 percent of manual bins and sampled positive-phi alpha_L helical and polyproline II states missed by fixed grids [Torrillo 2021](node:493). Across staphylococcal BdpA and four heterogeneous-backbone mimetics bearing beta3, Aib, or cyclic ACPC monomers, two-stage Weighted Ensemble and history-augmented Markov reweighting established that beta3 substitutions destabilize folding by expanding the unfolded ensemble from R_g = 12.7 A to 14.5-14.8 A [Santhouse 2022](node:560), while steady-state explicit-solvent SPC/Eb folding runs reproduced temperature-jump and NMR k_f values across two orders of magnitude [Santhouse 2024](node:617). Recent ensemble audits further demonstrate that AI generators BioEmu, AFSample2, and ESMFlow produce discordant non-Boltzmann distributions insensitive to point mutations [Otten 2026](node:736), motivating Weighted Ensemble plus RiteWeight refinement of AI-seeded structures and cryo-EM particle ensembles [Ojha 2026](node:754).

review.title: Large Assemblies, Viral Spikes & Allostery
paragraphs: Allosteric switching in multi-domain proteins established the statistical path-ensemble principles later scaled to megadalton viral assemblies. Verified Weighted Ensemble simulations on united-residue calmodulin quantitatively matched brute-force transition rates, event-duration distributions, and pathway heterogeneity with up to 100-fold speedup at low temperature [Zhang 2007](node:242), extending earlier calmodulin path sampling [Zuckerman 2004](node:225). Semiatomistic adenylate kinase simulations resolved two competing open-to-closed channels obeying forward-reverse pathway flux symmetry [Bhatt 2010](node:91), while mixed-resolution Monte Carlo and multi-state SAXS modeling addressed flexible receptor ensembles [Spiriti 2019](node:423) and [Schneidman-Duhovny 2016](node:335). Coupled with engineered Cu(II) EPR and Q-band DEER spectroscopy, Minimal Adaptive Binning Weighted Ensemble captured mutually exclusive helix alpha9 docking underlying negative cooperativity in human glutathione S-transferase A1-1 [Bogetti 2023](node:604), bimodal open-state lobes in lysine-arginine-ornithine binding protein [Palit 2026](node:716), internal water-filled pocket opening in ARNT PAS-B [Xu 2024](node:646), slow-off-rate RAMP3-mediated selectivity at the adrenomedullin 2 GPCR [Babin 2023](node:592), and dimeric hormone rescue of endosomal signaling in hypocalcemia-associated PTHR25C [Pacheco 2025](node:688).

Glycosylated SARS-CoV-2 spike activation pushed continuous unbiased atomistic Weighted Ensemble past the half-million-atom barrier. Coupling WESTPA on 100 GPUs with multiscale viral envelope modeling up to 305 million atoms [Casalino 2021](node:502), equilibrium Weighted Ensemble over 130 microseconds harvested 310 continuous RBD down-to-up and down-to-open pathways, establishing that the N-glycan at N343 operates like a molecular crowbar gating RBD lift-off, a mechanism validated by a ~56 percent drop in ACE2 binding for N343A in biolayer interferometry [Sztain 2021](node:517), alongside downstream ACE2 peptidase-domain perturbations [Uyar 2021](node:516). Integrating WESTPA 2.0 [Russo 2022](node:536) with convolutional variational autoencoder latent coordinates in DeepDriveMD sampled over 800 Delta spike opening pathways within 72 microseconds and introduced parallelized memory-optimized history-augmented Markov postprocessing to extract steady-state opening rate estimates from transient terabyte wild-type trajectories [Dommer 2022](node:563). Comparative Minimal Adaptive Binning Weighted Ensemble across Ancestral, Delta, and Omicron BA.1 spikes further demonstrated that breaking the D614-K854 salt bridge gates Ancestral opening while Omicron BA.1 accesses a hyper-open peel conformation, carefully reporting mean pathway sampling times (40.59 ns, 11.68 ns, and 17.70 ns) to quantify relative readiness rather than rate constants [Kearns 2026](node:670).

Beyond single glycoproteins, Weighted Ensemble probes supra-molecular capsid assembly and cell-surface spatial reorganization across extreme timescale gaps. For Hepatitis B virus, WESTPA driving tabulated rigid-dimer Gō Monte Carlo accelerated energy evaluations up to 6700-fold to sample the final quarter of 120-dimer icosahedral capsid completion [Spiriti 2015](node:315), while all-atom Weighted Ensemble on core-protein tetramers bound to class I (GLS4) and class II (AT-130) capsid assembly modulators mapped assembly-active conformational shifts [Lynch 2025](node:692). At the cellular interface scale, spatial stochastic Weighted Ensemble simulations of T-cell receptor kinetic segregation confirmed that spontaneous diffusive evacuation of monomeric CD45 phosphatase from close-contact zones requires ~300 years, whereas weak hexameric CD45 oligomerization (K_D ~ 460 microM) compresses evacuation mean first-passage times below 1 second [Taylor 2022](node:533).

review.title: Membranes, Permeation & Channels
paragraphs: Membrane transport and channel gating confront Weighted Ensemble with anisotropic lipid relaxation, transmembrane potentials, and coupled hydration defects. Early multi-coordinate Weighted Ensemble path sampling on a coarse-grained double-Gō model of the sodium-benzylhydantoin symporter Mhp1 quantified outward-open to inward-open alternating access at 23.9 +- 1.7 ms^-1 and verified that 68 percent of transitions obey strict gate alternation [Adelman 2011](node:265). Extending steady-state Weighted Ensemble to narrow ion pores under applied transmembrane voltages generated single-channel current-voltage curves [Adelman 2015](node:231), while recent Weighted Ensemble studies resolved lipid scrambling rates in nhTMEM16 [Stephens 2022](node:527), voltage-sensor activation pathways in the human Hv1 proton channel [Shen 2026](node:755), electrostatic intermediate channeling [Liu 2019](node:415), and hydraulic membrane permeability effects on squeezing extracellular fluid out of transient cell-cell contacts [Liu 2019](node:418).

For passive small-molecule permeation and membrane-embedded receptor kinetics, Weighted Ensemble circumvents the memoryless 1D Smoluchowski approximation of classical inhomogeneous solubility-diffusion integrals. Formulating permeability through P_m = k_DA l_D under absorbing acceptor boundary conditions (C_A = 0) and bulk-water donor thickness l_D, Minimal Adaptive Binning combined with WESS reweighting in WESTPA 2.0 [Russo 2022](node:536) cut simulation cost threefold across POPC bilayers, producing log P_m of -4.27 +- 0.24 for tacrine (MFPT 4.6 ms from 8.1 microseconds), -5.32 +- 0.22 for sotalol (MFPT 52.1 ms from 6.3 microseconds), and -6.35 +- 0.22 for (R)-zacopride (MFPT 559.2 ms from 6.0 microseconds) [Zhang 2022](node:537), standardized further in double-bilayer tutorials [Bogetti 2023](node:579). Coupling Weighted Ensemble with continuous constant-pH molecular dynamics demonstrated that on-the-fly neutral-to-protonated state switching governs extreme membrane partitioning and potency of fentanyl [Clayton 2026](node:702). In parallel, 40 microseconds of REVO sampling on membrane-embedded TSPO demonstrated that PK-11195 dissociates laterally between transmembrane helices into the lipid phase rather than water, locating the binding transition state inside the membrane with 28 to 260 min pose mean first-passage times near the 34 min human residence time [Dixon 2020](node:486), a mechanism extended to membrane GPCR dissociation [Han 2025](node:685).

Highly charged cell-penetrating peptides and nanomaterials expose acute sensitivity to progress-coordinate resolution and periodic bilayer finite-size effects. Initial all-atom Weighted Ensemble runs on nona-arginine (Arg9) in a 4-to-1 DOPC/DOPG bilayer under a 0.05 V/nm electric field with 0.25 A z-bins stalled inside the hydrophobic core at z = -17.6 A with zero crossings [Choe 2021](node:523). Narrowing z-bin spacing to 0.10 A and extending target boundaries to -45 A permitted spontaneous Arg9 translocation within tens of nanoseconds via transient water pores, guanidinium reorientation, and piggybacking lipid headgroups [Choe 2023](node:573), supporting systematic comparisons across arginine-rich peptides [Choe 2024](node:653) and spontaneous carbon nanotube bilayer penetration [Choe 2026](node:721). Simultaneously, systematic box-scaling analyses of phase-separating bilayers [Poruthoor 2024](node:649) highlight that lateral lipid correlation lengths and Yeh-Hummer periodic hydrodynamic drag [Yeh 2004](node:183) must be controlled when converting finite-patch Weighted Ensemble fluxes into macroscopic membrane transport coefficients.

review.title: Collective Variables & Deep Learning
paragraphs: Collective variables and pathway clustering in Weighted Ensemble workflows depend on chirality preserving alignment metrics and mathematically valid partitioning algorithms. Unconstrained orthogonal superposition in [Kabsch 1976](node:278) permitted improper inversions with det(U) = -1 on macromolecular coordinates, prompting the proper special orthogonal rotation determinant correction in [Kabsch 1978](node:249), equivalent traceless 4x4 quaternion eigenproblem and analytic RMSD gradient derivations in [Coutsias, Seok & Dill 2004](node:269), purely algebraic Procrustes proofs in [Lawrence, Bernal & Witzgall 2019](node:429), and graph isomorphism symmetry corrections for degenerate ligand atom ordering in [Meli & Biggin 2020](node:471). Discretizing conformational and pathway ensembles draws on mixture model Integrated Completed Likelihood selection in [Biernacki, Celeux & Govaert 2000](node:251), weighted cluster design effect variance bounds in [Gabler, Haeder & Lahiri 1999](node:7), fast k medoids swaps in [Park & Jun 2008](node:220) and [Schubert & Rousseeuw 2019](node:396), Average Silhouette Width optimization in [Batool & Hennig 2021](node:462), and nearest neighbor chain agglomerative clustering in [Mullner 2011](node:47). Extending discrete pathway strings in [Bogetti et al. 2023](node:616) and linear time n ary frame set dissimilarities in [Chen et al. 2025](node:674), [Woody Santos et al. 2026](node:751) introduced PRISM medoid Hausdorff distances to prevent amorphous frame cloud collapse, while empirical titration rules in [Olsson et al. 2011](node:329) assign protonation states prior to simulation.

Low dimensional kinetic coordinates reviewed by [Noe & Clementi 2017](node:359) progressed from spectral Voronoi committor approximations in [Ahn, Grate & Darve 2017](node:361) and state free reversible VAMPnets in [Chen, Sidky & Ferguson 2019](node:426) to State Predictive Information Bottleneck (SPIB) encoders in [Mehdi et al. 2022](node:534). Individual replica weight conservation proven by [Zhang, Jasnow & Zuckerman 2010](node:252) permits online neural collective variable updates between Weighted Ensemble cycles without biasing path statistics. Purely data driven SPIB encoders trained on early trajectories compress visited basins while collapsing unsampled barriers, a blind spot resolved in [Wang & Tiwary 2024](node:640) by pairing SPIB slow modes in explored basins with expert coordinates in unexplored regions. Online coordinate learning expanded to convolutional variational autoencoders with latent Local Outlier Factor scoring for NTL9 folding in [Leung et al. 2025](node:672), discriminant analysis coordinate optimization in [Prabhakar & Chakrabarty 2025](node:683), neural network guided pathway kinetics in [Maity 2026](node:741), machine learned RiteWeight representations in [Kania 2026](node:752), and semigroup consistent neural committor learning in [Chen 2026](node:759).

Deep structure predictors reshaped seed ensemble generation through [Jumper et al. 2021](node:512) (AlphaFold2), [Abramson et al. 2024](node:635) (AlphaFold3), and co folding affinity models in [Passaro et al. 2025](node:680), alongside machine learned potential benchmarks in [Aghili et al. 2025](node:695). Residue confidence scores still misrepresent conformational ensembles when [Alderson et al. 2023](node:609) established that AlphaFold2 assigns high pLDDT values to conditionally folded intrinsically disordered regions that remain disordered in apo solution, and [Mehdiabadi, Tosatto & Piovesan 2025](node:698) documented bimodal pLDDT distributions and diffusion driven secondary structure hallucinations inside disordered tails of AlphaFold3. Multiple sequence alignment subsampling increases conformational spread without Boltzmann probabilities, motivating AlphaFold2 RAVE reweighting in [Vani et al. 2023](node:596) and Weighted Ensemble propagation paired with discretization free RiteWeight stationary estimation in [Otten et al. 2026](node:725) to reconcile divergent AFSample2 and ESMFlow adenylate kinase ensembles with experimental open state populations.

review.title: Statistical Estimators & Sibling Rare Event Methods
paragraphs: Accurate rare event kinetics depends upon physically valid microscopic integrators, geometric state metrics, and steady state flux identities. Stochastic velocity rescaling [Bussi, Donadio & Parrinello 2007](node:184) augments Berendsen kinetic relaxation with an exact Wiener diffusion term, preserving canonical kinetic energy distributions and supplying stochastic trajectory divergence required when cloning walkers [Schultze, Kozlowski & Grubmuller 2026](node:761). Geometric progress coordinates and Voronoi tessellations rely upon proper special orthogonal rotational alignment [Kabsch 1978](node:249) correcting improper orthogonal reflections in [Kabsch 1976](node:278) [Coutsias, Seok & Dill 2004](node:269) [Lawrence, Bernal & Witzgall 2019](node:429), alongside least squares Voronoi quantization [Lloyd 1982](node:289) refined iteratively within modern trajectory stratification [Strahan et al. 2024](node:647). Biochemical cycle flux theory [Hill 1989](node:29) anchors steady state Weighted Ensemble rate estimation [Bhatt, Zhang & Zuckerman 2010](node:182) [Baudel, Guyader & Lelievre 2022](node:470) [Kania 2026](node:752) by equating inverse mean first passage time to stationary target arrival flux.

Sibling rare event stratification methods trade continuous full trajectory histories for faster local convergence across hypersurfaces. [Faradjian & Elber 2004](node:194) introduced Milestoning to reconstruct non Markovian hopping timescales from local first passage distributions between reaction coordinate interfaces, later formalized mathematically via Exact Milestoning [Aristoff, Bello Rivas & Elber 2016](node:51). [Ray & Andricioaei 2020](node:443) unified both families in Weighted Ensemble Milestoning, accelerating milestone to milestone transitions without external biasing forces and recovering equilibrium milestone populations by multiplying the stationary hitting flux row eigenvector of the transition kernel by mean milestone lifetimes. Subsequent protein ligand dissociation benchmarks [Ray, Gokey, Mobley & Andricioaei 2020](node:468) exposed high run to run spread under single structure milestone seeding, motivating harmonic restraint release hypersurface ensembles.

Credible uncertainty quantification for Weighted Ensemble observables must confront both temporal autocorrelation and extreme between replicate skewness. Foundational finite sample variance adjustments [Horn, Horn & Duncan 1975](node:154) [MacKinnon 1985](node:87) and IID plug in bootstrap principles [Efron & Tibshirani 1994](node:106) [Davison & Hinkley 1997](node:561) break down when applied naively to serially correlated or hierarchically clustered trajectories. For dependent time series, [Hall, Horowitz & Jing 1995](node:152) proved that optimal block bootstrap lengths scale with distinct fractional powers n^(1/3), n^(1/4), and n^(1/5) across variance, one sided, and two sided interval targets, while [Ng, Grieve & Carpenter 2013](node:43) demonstrated that two stage cluster bootstraps double count within cluster variance unless shrinkage corrections from [Davison & Hinkley 1997](node:561) are enforced, and [Kitagawa 1996](node:216) established stratified state space filtering. Across independent atomistic Weighted Ensemble replicates spanning dozens of orders of magnitude, [Mostofian & Zuckerman 2019](node:385) and [Mostofian & Zuckerman 2019](node:407) demonstrated severe downward log space confidence bound bias in standard bootstrap and roughly 30 percent mean undercoverage even under Dirichlet Bayesian bootstrapping.

opportunities.title: Hilbert curve intrabin ordering for zero cost resampling variance reduction
opportunities.summary: Within bin cloning and merging in Weighted Ensemble engines typically orders walkers arbitrarily before residual or systematic selection, forfeiting multidimensional spatial negative association proven in Gerber, Chopin and Whiteley (2019).
opportunities.first_steps: Sort walkers inside each occupied bin along a d dimensional Hilbert curve over auxiliary collective variables prior to residual stratified selection, then benchmark empirical flux variance scaling against unordered binned multinomial resampling on synthetic Trp cage Markov dynamics.

opportunities.title: Joint benchmark of merging bias corrected MSMs against history labeled and iterative reweighting estimators
opportunities.summary: Bose, Kilinc and Dickson (2025) correct multi lag pruning distortion via MBC MSMs while Aristoff, Webber and Zuckerman (2026) demonstrate directional steady state lumping error in unlabeled coarse matrices, with relative bias variance tradeoffs unquantified on shared datasets.
opportunities.first_steps: Evaluate MBC MSMs across lag multiples m = 1, 2, 5, 10 alongside alpha beta labeled rate matrices and iterative trajectory reweighting on the exact 8 microstate analytical chain and 17 microsecond soluble epoxide hydrolase REVO trajectories.

opportunities.title: Shrinkage corrected hierarchical cluster block bootstrap for multi replicate Weighted Ensemble fluxes
opportunities.summary: Current Weighted Ensemble uncertainty pipelines either apply Dirichlet Bayesian bootstrap to scalar per run mean fluxes (Mostofian & Zuckerman 2019) or block bootstrap pooled flux traces without correcting two stage cluster variance inflation (Davison & Hinkley 1997, Ng, Grieve & Carpenter 2013) or distinguishing n^(1/3) variance blocks from n^(1/5) two sided interval blocks (Hall, Horowitz & Jing 1995).
opportunities.first_steps: Implement a two stage Dirichlet replicate plus shrinkage corrected block bootstrap with target matched block exponents on the 15 NTL9 and 13 Protein G WESTPA datasets and measure empirical 95 percent interval coverage on synthetic heavy tailed renewal processes.

opportunities.title: Exact Milestoning stationary entry flux iteration inside Weighted Ensemble Milestoning
opportunities.summary: Single structure milestone initialization in Ray and Andricioaei (2020) inflates protein ligand k_off variance, whereas harmonic restraint release seeding in Ray, Gokey, Mobley and Andricioaei (2020) approximates equilibrium slice Boltzmann weights rather than the true non equilibrium first hitting density of Exact Milestoning (Aristoff, Bello Rivas & Elber 2016).
opportunities.first_steps: Propagate terminal milestone hitting coordinates and weights across iterative Weighted Ensemble Milestoning cycles without harmonic restraints and quantify k_off and free energy bias relative to Exact Milestoning on a 2D Muller Brown potential and FKBP ligand dissociation.

opportunities.title: Unified RED and RiteWeight Rate Estimator with Lugsail Genealogical Intervals
opportunities.summary: Pre steady state Weighted Ensemble rate calculations confront simultaneous finite event duration ramp bias in [DeGrave, Bogetti & Chong 2021](node:499), fixed bin reweighting discretization bias in [Kania et al. 2026](node:733), and negative first order O(1/b) covariance bias under positive serial correlation in [Vats & Flegal 2021](node:461). Existing workflows apply RED, haMSM, or RiteWeight separately without accounting for shared walker genealogy in confidence interval widths.
opportunities.first_steps: Evaluate synthetic and 208 us atomistic Trp cage Weighted Ensemble segments from [Kania 2026](node:752) alongside calbindin switching runs reanalyzed in [DeGrave, Bogetti & Chong 2021](node:499). Compute stationary segment weights via RiteWeight paired with subtraction free GTH linear solves from [Grassmann, Taksar & Heyman 1985](node:93), normalize sink arrival weights by the RED cumulative event duration integral after MSER 5 startup truncation from [White, Cobb & Spratt 2002](node:548), and measure empirical coverage of lugsail batch means intervals across independent replicates.

opportunities.title: Quantifying Reactive Boundary Entry Recycling Bias in Cavity Unbinding Kinetics
opportunities.summary: [Baudel, Guyader & Lelievre 2023](node:470) proved that inverse stationary sink flux reproduces the equilibrium mean reaction time strictly when recycled trajectories sample the reactive boundary entry distribution on boundary A rather than a single crystal pose or Boltzmann basin slice, while inertial Langevin dynamics in [Copperman & Zuckerman 2020](node:411) fall outside the one dimensional overdamped Smoluchowski monotonicity bounds of [Copperman et al. 2019](node:399). Recycling unbinding walkers to a single bound pose risks multi decade flux distortion when internal pocket gates relax slowly.
opportunities.first_steps: Build two color history labeled equilibrium and source sink ensembles modeled on [Suarez & Zuckerman 2014](node:308) and [Pratt et al. 2019](node:417) across inertial Langevin 2D potentials from [Copperman & Zuckerman 2020](node:411) and host guest dissociation systems from [Ray et al. 2020](node:468). Measure total variation distance between single pose feedback, Boltzmann basin initiation, and empirical reactive boundary entry distributions, then compare inverse flux MFPT errors against theoretical quasi stationary bias bounds from [Baudel, Guyader & Lelievre 2023](node:470).

opportunities.title: Audit merging bias and quasi unbound variance inflation across binless Weighted Ensemble resamplers
opportunities.summary: Standard REVO, Cutoff REVO, MABL, and CoWERA apply distinct pairwise distance exponents and cloning eligibility cutoffs that alter exit weight distributions and multi lag Markov state model residence times.
opportunities.first_steps: Run matched 48 walker ensembles in wepy and WESTPA 2.0 on T4 lysozyme L99A p xylene and SAMPL6 OA G6 across resampling intervals of 10, 50, and 100 ps, then compare Hill flux against standard MSMs and merging bias corrected MBC MSMs across lag multiples from 2 to 10.

opportunities.title: Couple early MAB uphill bottleneck isolation to online haMSM discrepancy variance walker allocation
opportunities.summary: Pre steady state iterations lack reactive trajectories to parameterize microbin discrepancy functions h(x) and v(x), whereas heuristic MAB and MABL maintain uniform walker counts per bin even after barrier crossing commences.
opportunities.first_steps: Implement a two stage WESTPA 2.0 resampler driven by MAB uphill bottleneck selection during initial barrier ascent and transitioning to microbin haMSM w_u sigma_u walker allocation once target flux stabilizes, benchmarking flux variance on SynMD Trp cage and atomistic chignolin.

opportunities.title: Benchmark conditionally folded IDR false positive pLDDT structures under Weighted Ensemble plus RiteWeight equilibration
opportunities.summary: Conditionally folded disordered regions exhibiting AlphaFold2 pLDDT >= 70 and hallucinated AlphaFold3 helices distort progress coordinate bounds and initial seed weights when mistaken for stable apo folds.
opportunities.first_steps: Select 10 conditionally folded human disordered segments from Alderson et al. (2023) alongside apo disordered controls from Mehdiabadi et al. (2025), seed explicit solvent Weighted Ensemble trajectories in OPC water from AlphaFold2, AlphaFold3, and AFSample2 models, and apply RiteWeight to evaluate relaxation toward experimental NMR chemical shifts.

opportunities.title: Quantify latent space rotation hysteresis and Kish effective sample size drop during online neural coordinate retraining
opportunities.summary: Periodic retraining of SPIB or convolutional VAE encoders rotates latent coordinates between Weighted Ensemble cycles, risking destructive merges of previously separated bottleneck trajectories and finite sample weight skew.
opportunities.first_steps: Instrument WESTPA 2.0 on SynMD NTL9 and atomistic chignolin across retraining intervals of 5, 25, and 100 cycles, track Kish effective sample size (sum w_i)^2 / sum w_i^2 across encoder updates, and evaluate Orthogonal Procrustes latent alignment between consecutive neural checkpoints.

opportunities.title: Controlled bias variance benchmark of block validated haMSMs against BAD NEUS and RiteWeight
opportunities.summary: [Russo et al. 2021](node:510) established asymptotic coarse grained MFPT and committor consistency once sliding window weights relax under source sink boundaries, while [Suarez et al. 2021](node:495) proved frame interval accuracy of unsymmetrized haMSMs. A controlled finite sample benchmark comparing odd even block cross validated k means haMSMs, [BAD NEUS](node:647) spectral stratification, and [RiteWeight](node:749) random tessellation reweighting on identical transient Weighted Ensemble segments remains missing.
opportunities.first_steps: Sample off equilibrium walker ensembles on the 49x49 Smoluchowski surface of [Aristoff et al. 2023](node:570) and explicit solvent Chignolin from [Chen et al. 2026](node:759), then measure root mean square log MFPT and committor error across microbin count, trajectory window length S, and odd even iteration splits.

opportunities.title: Phase space discrepancy coordinates with momentum features for low friction atomistic folding
opportunities.summary: [Aristoff et al. 2023](node:570) proved asymptotic flux variance optimality for rectangular bins in discrepancy h(x) and local variation v(x), whereas low friction atomistic folding runs still display large replicate spread and [Chen et al. 2026](node:759) emphasized that underdamped Langevin committors depend on joint configuration momentum states (X_t, P_t).
opportunities.first_steps: Train the stop gradient semigroup committor solver of [Chen et al. 2026](node:759) with and without velocity inputs across low friction and water friction Langevin regimes, then supply learned discrepancy and variation coordinates to WESTPA 2.0 adaptive allocation [Russo et al. 2022](node:536).

opportunities.title: Shared ancestor tree correlation and loop erasure benchmark for LPATH pathway histograms
opportunities.summary: [Bogetti et al. 2023](node:616) clusters condensed state symbol strings traced from WESTPA splitting trees in LPATH, whereas [Suarez & Zuckerman 2018](node:398) removes diffusive recrossings through shortest path fundamental sequences. Quantifying how shared parent branches in Weighted Ensemble trees and state alphabet resolution perturb inferred route weights will establish calibrated uncertainty intervals for pathway classes.
opportunities.first_steps: Generate synthetic branching path ensembles with known ground truth route fractions on the two channel potential of [Suarez & Zuckerman 2018](node:398) and alanine dipeptide data from [Bogetti et al. 2023](node:616), comparing condensed string LPATH clusters against fundamental sequences and ancestor block bootstrap intervals.

opportunities.title: Persistent multi walker GPU batching with asynchronous HDF5 lineage streaming for neural potentials
opportunities.summary: [Russo et al. 2022](node:536) shrank trajectory file footprints by up to 85 percent through per iteration HDF5 archives in WESTPA 2.0, and [Aghili et al. 2025](node:695) benchmarked neural molecular dynamics propagators across nine proteins via WESTPA and TICA metrics. Per iteration worker launch latency and host device serialization still limit short tau neural potential throughput.
opportunities.first_steps: Couple persistent batched multi walker GPU contexts in [OpenMM 7](node:416) and [wepy](node:487) with asynchronous HDF5 lineage writers from [Russo et al. 2022](node:536) and low variance pruning from [Plotnikov & Ahn 2024](node:645) on the nine protein suite of [Aghili et al. 2025](node:695).

opportunities.title: Deconvolving Force-Field Polarization, Protonation, and Resampling Bias in Interior Cavity k_off
opportunities.summary: Steady-state Minimal Adaptive Binning Weighted Ensemble reproduced experimental gating mutagenesis in HIF-2alpha PAS-B while overestimating k_off 10^4-fold under fixed-charge ff19SB and GAFF2, whereas naive Markov models on REVO unbinding trajectories suffered 30-fold merging bias prior to MBC-MSM. A unified cross-estimator and polarizable/constant-pH benchmark on interior cavity dissociation is missing.
opportunities.first_steps: Re-simulate THS-017 escape from HIF-2alpha PAS-B (PDB 3H7W) and benzene escape from T4 lysozyme L99A (PDB 1L83) comparing fixed-charge ff19SB/OPC (with Ando 2023 temperature-matched viscosity scaling) against Drude polarizable Weighted Ensemble, then evaluate identical trajectory trees with raw Hill flux, RED, MBC-MSM, and RiteWeight against ZZ-exchange NMR k_off = 1.4 s^-1.

opportunities.title: Box-Size, Viscosity, and Constant-pH Corrected Explicit-Solvent Bimolecular Association and Permeation Suite
opportunities.summary: Explicit-solvent Weighted Ensemble k_on and membrane permeability P_m studies routinely omit Yeh-Hummer 1/L periodic hydrodynamic self-diffusion corrections, apply temperature-independent water viscosity ratios, or freeze ionizable solute charge states across low-dielectric bilayers, masking force-field errors behind compensating transport artifacts.
opportunities.first_steps: Run barnase-barstar association across three cubic box sizes (L = 8, 11, and 15 nm) in TIP3P and OPC water at 283 K, 298 K, and 310 K to verify collapse onto a single box-independent k_on after Yeh-Hummer and Ando Green-Kubo viscosity corrections, and benchmark tacrine and zacopride POPC permeation under constant-pH Weighted Ensemble across varying bulk-water slab thicknesses l_D.

story.title: Particle Splitting & Staged Brownian Encounter Surfaces
story.body: Decades before biomolecular path ensembles, [Wall & Erpenbeck 1959](node:132) split and weighted polymer chains while [Northrup, McCammon & Karplus 1980](node:205) staged diffusional barrier crossings and [Hill 1989](node:29) proved exact reactive cycle flux.

story.title: Huber & Kim Unify Staged Bins with Unbiased Resampling
story.body: In 1996, [Huber & Kim 1996](node:109) combined Brownian encounter bins with statistically exact walker cloning and merging at fixed intervals tau, founding Weighted Ensemble simulation.

story.title: General Stochastic Exactness, Steady States & WESTPA
story.body: [Zhang, Jasnow & Zuckerman 2010](node:252) established exactness for arbitrary stochastic dynamics and adaptive bins, [Bhatt et al. 2010](node:262) solved steady state reweighting, and [Zwier et al. 2015](node:332) launched WESTPA.

story.title: Adaptive Binning & Non Markovian Rate Estimators
story.body: High dimensional barrier crossing surged ahead through [Dickson & Brooks 2014](node:328) (WExplore), Donyapour et al. 2019 (REVO), [Torrillo et al. 2021](node:493) (MAB), and transient bias removal via [DeGrave et al. 2021](node:499) (RED).

story.title: Million Atom Viral Spikes, haMSM & RiteWeight
story.body: GPU ensembles opened glycosylated coronaviral spikes in [Sztain et al. 2021](node:517), while [Copperman & Zuckerman 2020](node:475) and [Kania et al. 2026](node:733) removed Markovian lag and bin discretization biases.

story.title: Auditing 311 Full Texts, 2,990 Equations & 39 Findings
story.body: Two pass verification across extracted LaTeX equations, published errata, and 1,922 citing sentences illuminates where merge biases, coarse Markovian lumping, bootstrap skewness, and boundary recycling assumptions propagate across the cylinder.
